items.text: 2026-08-01. Mara started project Larch. They chose BATCH-0-741 for batch delivery. The initial retry policy was RETRY-0-108.

2026-08-08. Mara reported that BATCH-0-741 lost updates during GATE-0-519 outages. The team tested REPLAY-0-632, which restored the missing updates. No change of delivery mode was approved at this meeting.

2026-08-15. Mara approved switching Larch from BATCH-0-741 to STREAM-0-286. This supersedes the August 1 delivery decision. The cause was the GATE-0-519 outages recorded on August 8; keep the successful recovery procedure from that incident.

2026-08-22. Mara reviewed Larch. Keep the August 15 delivery choice. For the next outage, use the recovery procedure validated on August 8. The retry policy is now RETRY-0-907, superseding RETRY-0-108. No budget owner has been appointed.

2026-08-01. Morgan owns the Delta project DELTA-8. BATCH-8-741 is the approved delivery mode and RETRY-8-108 the retry policy.
2026-08-08. Delta DELTA-8 suffered incident GATE-8-519. REPLAY-8-632 restored missing updates. BATCH-8-741 remained approved after the meeting.

2026-08-15. Delta DELTA-8 decision log A approves STREAM-8-286 effective August 15 because of GATE-8-519 and retains REPLAY-8-632. Independent decision log B approves QUEUE-8-440 for the same project effective August 15. Neither log retracts or supersedes the other.

2026-08-22. Delta DELTA-8 retains both conflicting August 15 decision logs, with no adjudication. The approved retry policy is still RETRY-8-108. RETRY-8-907 is only a proposal for September 1 and has not been approved. This review contains no budget-owner appointment information. It does not establish that the role is unassigned.
